backend/main.mo: Main backend canister implementing authorization, user profiles, mark submission, validation, and storage of persistent marks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old userProfiles and marks list into new persistentMarks map keyed by student, subject, and assessment.
feature_evidence.json: Feature-evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend source files for quick reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styles defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app controlling auth, splash, profile setup, navigation, and rendering of all major screens.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity with loading state and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog for first-time profile creation, capturing user name and saving to backend.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout component providing header, navigation, main content area, and footer, with view switching based on selected session and student.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Animated splash screen showing the app title and author before auto-transitioning.
frontend/src/features/marks/MarksEntrySc: Marks entry UI for a selected student, loading existing marks, validating input, and saving via mutations.
frontend/src/features/results/SessionRes: Generates and displays final session-wide results with subject-wise weighted calculations and rounding logic.
frontend/src/features/results/StudentRes: Displays final weighted subject results and grand total for a single student with explanation of calculation method.
frontend/src/features/sessions/SessionsS: Manages academic sessions stored in localStorage, allowing creation and selection of sessions.
frontend/src/features/students/StudentsS: Manages students within a session, allowing adding new students and selecting one for marks entry.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication via AuthClient, including login state and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarks.ts: Hooks for fetching and submitting student marks with automatic query invalidation on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useResults.ts: Hooks to retrieve final subject results and session reports from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Hooks to fetch, save, and retrieve the caller's user profile and role using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/marksConstants.ts: Defines subject and assessment constants plus helpers for full marks and labels.
frontend/src/lib/marksValidation.ts: Validates mark inputs for numeric correctness, non-negativity, and value limits.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, themes, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, including features, issues, and new requests focused on persistent mark storage, two‑stage rounding, and generating a final results sheet. Also records existing features, architectural notes, and a known persistence bug.
